Specification: This module specifies and proves properties of a voting protocol in which acceptors maintain a set of votes and a maximum ballot seen. The spec includes the TLA+ translation of a PlusCal algorithm where each acceptor can either increase its maximum ballot or cast a vote for a value at a ballot, subject to a recursively defined safety condition SafeAt. The module proves inductive invariants and agreement-style properties, connects the voting spec to an instantiated Consensus specification, and adds an explicit liveness assumption based on weak fairness for fixed ballot actions together with a stability condition excluding higher ballots.

THEOREM RecursiveFcnOfNat ==
          ASSUME NEW Def(_,_), 
                 \A n \in Nat : 
                    \A g, h : (\A i \in 0..(n-1) : g[i] = h[i]) => (Def(g, n) = Def(h, n))
          PROVE  LET f[n \in Nat] == Def(f, n)
                 IN  f = [n \in Nat |-> Def(f, n)]

THEOREM SafeAtProp ==
  \A b \in Ballot, v \in Value :
    SafeAt(b, v) =
      \/ b = 0
      \/ \E Q \in Quorum :
           /\ \A a \in Q : maxBal[a] \geq b
           /\ \E c \in -1..(b-1) :
                /\ (c # -1) => /\ SafeAt(c, v)
                               /\ \A a \in Q :
                                    \A w \in Value :
                                        VotedFor(a, c, w) => (w = v)
                /\ \A d \in (c+1)..(b-1), a \in Q : DidNotVoteIn(a, d)

THEOREM GeneralNatInduction == 
         \A f : /\ f[0]
                /\ \A n \in Nat : (\A j \in 0..n : f[j]) => f[n+1]
                => \A n \in Nat : f[n]

LEMMA SafeLemma == 
       TypeOK => 
         \A b \in Ballot :
           \A v \in Value :
              SafeAt(b, v) => 
                \A c \in 0..(b-1) :
                  \E Q \in Quorum :
                    \A a \in Q : /\ maxBal[a] >= c
                                 /\ \/ DidNotVoteIn(a, c)
                                    \/ VotedFor(a, c, v)

LEMMA VT0 == /\ TypeOK
             /\ VInv1
             /\ VInv2
             => \A v, w \in Value, b, c \in Ballot : 
                   (b > c) /\ SafeAt(b, v) /\ ChosenIn(c, w) => (v = w)

THEOREM VT1 == /\ TypeOK 
               /\ VInv1
               /\ VInv2
               => \A v, w : 
                    (v \in chosen) /\ (w \in chosen) => (v = w)

LEMMA NextDef ==
  TypeOK => 
   (Next =  \E self \in Acceptor :
                 \E b \in Ballot : BallotAction(self, b) )

THEOREM VT4 == TypeOK /\ VInv2 /\ VInv3  =>
                \A Q \in Quorum, b \in Ballot :
                   (\A a \in Q : (maxBal[a] >= b)) => \E v \in Value : SafeAt(b,v)

ASSUME NEW Def(_,_), 
                 \A n \in Nat : 
                    \A g, h : (\A i \in 0..(n-1) : g[i] = h[i]) => (Def(g, n) = Def(h, n))
          PROVE  LET f[n \in Nat] == Def(f, n)
                 IN  f = [n \in Nat |-> Def(f, n)]

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW v \in Value
               PROVE  \A b \in Ballot : SafeAtProp!(b, v)

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW f,
                      f[0],
                      \A m \in Nat : (\A j \in 0..m : f[j]) => f[m+1],
                      NEW n \in Nat
               PROVE  f[n]

ASSUME NEW k \in Nat,  g[k]
      PROVE  g[k+1]

SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK
             PROVE  SafeLemma!2

ASSUME NEW b \in Ballot, P[b]
      PROVE  P[b+1]

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW v \in Value,
                        SafeAt(b+1, v),
                        NEW c \in 0..b
                 PROVE  \E Q \in Quorum :
                           \A a \in Q : /\ maxBal[a] >= c
                                        /\ \/ DidNotVoteIn(a, c)
                                           \/ VotedFor(a, c, v)

SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK, VInv1, VInv2,
                    NEW v \in Value, NEW w \in Value 
             PROVE  \A b, c \in Ballot : 
                      (b > c) /\ SafeAt(b, v) /\ ChosenIn(c, w) => (v = w)

ASSUME NEW b \in Ballot, \A i \in 0..b : P[i]
      PROVE  P[b+1]

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW c \in Ballot, b+1 > c, SafeAt(b+1, v), ChosenIn(c, w)
                 PROVE  v=w

SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK, VInv1, VInv2,
                      NEW v, NEW w, 
                      v \in chosen, w \in chosen
               PROVE  v = w

SUFFICES ASSUME VInv, 
                    NEW self \in Acceptor,
                    NEW b \in Ballot, 
                    BallotAction(self, b)
             PROVE  VInv'

SUFFICES ASSUME VInv, vars' = vars
               PROVE  VInv'

ASSUME NEW a \in Acceptor, NEW c \in Ballot, NEW w \in Value,
             ~VotedFor(a, c, w), VotedFor(a, c, w)'
      PROVE  (a = self) /\ (c = b) /\ VoteFor(self, b, w)

ASSUME NEW c \in Ballot, NEW w \in Value,
             SafeAt(c, w)
      PROVE  SafeAt(c, w)'

ASSUME NEW d \in Ballot, P[d]
        PROVE  P[d+1]

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW e \in 0..(d+1), SafeAt(e, w)
                   PROVE  SafeAt(e, w)'
SUFFICES ASSUME Init PROVE VInv

ASSUME VInv, VInv', [Next]_vars
      PROVE  [C!Next]_C!vars

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW self \in Acceptor,
                        NEW b \in Ballot, 
                        BallotAction(self, b)
                 PROVE  [C!Next]_C!vars

ASSUME IncreaseMaxBal(self, b)
        PROVE  C!vars' = C!vars

ASSUME NEW v \in Value,
               VoteFor(self, b, v)
        PROVE  [C!Next]_C!vars

ASSUME NEW w \in chosen
          PROVE  w \in chosen'

ASSUME NEW w \in chosen,
                     v \in chosen'
          PROVE  w = v

ASSUME NEW w, w \notin chosen, w \in chosen'
          PROVE  w = v

SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK, VInv2, VInv3,
                      NEW Q \in Quorum, NEW b \in Ballot,
                      (\A a \in Q : (maxBal[a] >= b))
               PROVE  \E v \in Value : SafeAt(b, v)

SUFFICES ASSUME b # 0
               PROVE  \E v \in Value : SafeAt(b, v)

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW v \in Value,
                        <1>4!1!(v)
                 PROVE  SafeAt(b, v)
